product_updates.title: Anthropic gets its first court win over the Pentagon’s supply-chain risk label
product_updates.content: A federal judge ruled the Trump administration illegally labeled Anthropic a supply-chain risk, handing the AI company a victory as its second Pentagon lawsuit continues in Washington.
